title: Scientists put 78,000 letters of human DNA into a mouse — and unraveled how a rare disease worked
caption:
By inserting human genes into lab mice, researchers have reportedly unraveled the underlying mechanics of a rare disease that has proven notoriously difficult to study. According to Live Science on November 21, 2026, the scientific team successfully put 78,000 letters of human DNA into a mouse model to better understand the condition. While the experiment provides a new window into these complex biological processes, it remains to be seen how effectively this humanized mouse model will translate to future human treatments.
